deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Online Store" > "Themes" > "Actions" > "Edit code". Select the "templates" folder and open the "cart.liquid" file in a text editor.

Add the following code to the "cart.liquid" file to embed the returns reason capture form: `<form id="returns-reason-form" method="post" action="/returns-reason"> <label for="returns-reason">Reason for return:</label> <textarea id="returns-reason" name="returns-reason"></textarea> <button type="submit">Submit</button> </form>`

Create a new page in your Shopify admin panel and add a section to display the returns reason capture form. Use the following Liquid code: `{% section 'returns-reason-form' %} {% render 'returns-reason-form' %} {% endsection %}`,

Create a new snippet in your Shopify admin panel and add the following Liquid code to the "returns-reason-form.liquid" file: `<form id="returns-reason-form" method="post" action="/returns-reason"> <label for="returns-reason">Reason for return:</label> <textarea id="returns-reason" name="returns-reason"></textarea> <button type="submit">Submit</button> </form>`
Save and publish the changes to your Shopify theme. The returns reason capture form should now be visible on the cart page and other pages where the form is embedded.
